transformations: Decoded ZombieWalk_normal_scaled_fast.gif into transparent RGBA; retained source frames 0, 2, 4, 6 of 8.
Original arms point up: row north. Copied rotations 180, clockwise 90, counterclockwise 90 for south, east, west.
Packed four 64px frames per row and four cardinal rows; PNG optimize, no GIF runtime.
Quantized combined atlas to 256 palette colors using FASTOCTREE without dithering, preserving transparency.
assets.fallback: local SVG/CSS symbol; static on resource error
